notJoinedProblem.title: Forbidden
notJoinedProblem.detail: search pool: join the shared search pool to read it; only tenants that contribute their Search Console queries can read the pool

queryInvalidProblem.title: Invalid Request
queryInvalidProblem.detail: search pool: search must be at most 100 characters and limit 1 to 200

settingInvalidProblem.title: Invalid Request

siteBoundProblem.title: Forbidden
siteBoundProblem.detail: search pool: a credential bound to one Site cannot read or change the tenant's search pool

termsNotAcceptedProblem.title: Invalid Request
termsNotAcceptedProblem.detail: search pool: joining requires accepting the shared search pool terms; send termsVersion 2026-11-18 after reading https://custd.com/docs/terms/shared-search-pool/
